How old are you?
Lumos is for adults only. Enter your date of birth so we can check. We do not keep it — we check it and throw it away, and all that stays on your phone is that you passed.

You need to be 18 to use Lumos
That is the rule everywhere Lumos works, and there is no way around it. Come back on your eighteenth birthday.

Setting up your phone
Lumos is making your account. It happens on this phone and takes a moment.
There is no sign-up. Lumos never asks for your phone number, your email address or a login from anywhere else, and nothing about you is sent to us.
This works with no internet connection.

Visible Nearby
You are not visible to anyone right now. Nothing is being broadcast from your phone.
People nearby who are also using Lumos can see that you are around. You can turn this off at any time and it stops immediately.
Lumos never turns this on by itself — not when you install it, not when it updates, not when you restart your phone, and not when you allow Bluetooth. Only you turn it on.
Turn on Visible Nearby
Turn off
Save a copy of your Lumos content
This makes one file holding your profile, your photos\' details, your block list and your settings. You choose a passphrase, and the file is locked with it.

Your account keys are not in the file, and they cannot be. If you lose this phone, this file brings your content back — but you will be a new person to everyone you had met, and they will have to check it is really you.
Choose a passphrase you will still remember in a year, and write it down somewhere safe. Nobody can open this file without it and nobody can reset it for you — not us, not anyone.
You decide where this file goes. Once you save it somewhere, it is out of Lumos\'s hands. Putting it in a cloud drive or a shared folder means whoever can reach that folder has the file.
Save the file
Bring your content back
Choose the file you saved and enter its passphrase.
You will start again as a new person on Lumos. Your content comes back, but your old matches do not, and anyone you were talking to will be asked to check it is really you before carrying on.
That did not open. Either the passphrase is wrong or the file is not one Lumos made. We cannot tell you which — telling you would help someone guessing.
Some things were not in this file because Lumos could not save them yet when you made it. They are not lost — they were never in there.
Start again as someone new
Your profile, your photos and your block list stay. Everything about who you are to other people is replaced.
Anyone you have matched with will lose the connection, and any conversation you were having cannot be carried on. This cannot be undone.
Type the words: new identity
new identity
Reset my identity
Emergency wipe
This erases everything Lumos holds on this phone: your profile, your photos, your block list, your settings and your account keys.
This cannot be undone, there is no confirmation email, and there is nothing to restore from unless you already saved a recovery file.
Your keys are destroyed first. If the wipe is interrupted — your phone dies, someone takes it out of your hands — whatever is left behind is unreadable.
Small traces may sit in unused parts of your phone\'s storage until it reuses them. They are locked and the key is already gone, so they cannot be read.
Type the words: erase everything
erase everything
Erase everything now
It is gone.
Nearby
Shown while Lumos is finding people near you.
Lumos is on
Lumos is finding people near you. Open the app to stop.

Finding people near you works over Bluetooth, between phones, with no internet needed. Chatting with your matches when you are apart uses the internet. That is the whole of it — there is no account behind either.
To see people near you — and be seen — Lumos needs the Bluetooth permission. It is only used while Nearby is on.
Without Bluetooth permission you cannot see people nearby or be seen by them. Your profile, matches and chats still work.
To take a photo for your profile, Lumos needs the camera.
Without camera permission you cannot take a new photo here. You can still choose one from your library.
You pick a photo; Lumos receives only the one you picked.
You did not pick a photo. Nothing else changes.
To record a voice note, Lumos needs the microphone. It records only while you hold the button.
Without microphone permission you cannot record voice notes. Text chat still works.
Lumos uses notifications to show when it is finding people near you, and when a message arrives.
Without notifications you will not see new messages until you open the app. Everything inside the app still works.
Visible Nearby

While this is on, people near you can see your preview. You choose for how long — an hour, a custom time, or until you leave the venue — and it turns itself off when that ends. It never turns itself on.
